name: test-cases-generator-from-codebases
description: Claude Code skill package that derives a fully-traceable, execution-ready test suite from static investigation of a codebase alone - no running application, no API access, no UI access. One run produces exactly two files: a CSV of test cases with full procedures, and a Markdown report holding coverage, gaps, assumptions and traceability. A scope narrower than the whole repo is a seed, not a filter: the dependency closure of what it calls is covered too, and unreadable dependencies become boundary surfaces with named failure modes.
author: AtefSaber-sheen
